commands.command: 12-gate format, unit, cross-target compile, release, and QEMU matrix
commands.summary: 9 board tests, 2 BCM tests, 3 RISC-V SoC tests, six compile lanes, RV64 release build, and QEMU boot passed.

beforeAfter.before: Raspberry Pi 3 board identity and fallback policy were embedded in kernel paths and the descriptor shape required RISC-V-only controllers.
beforeAfter.after: A root board descriptor owns Raspberry Pi 3 integration data while kernel consumers reuse shared mechanisms and BCM27xx SoC facts.

evidenceBoundary: QEMU RV64 runtime verified; Raspberry Pi 3, VF2, and Pioneer compile-only for this slice.
